papers.title: Semantic Direct Modeling
papers.topic: C. 特征识别与设计意图
papers.why: 语义直接建模：在**已有几何**上按语义定位并修改面/特征（“把这个面偏移 2mm”），对应我们的「参数页改尺寸即时重建」，可用它的面-特征映射提升可编辑性
papers.excerpt: [2504.13893] Semantic Direct Modeling Semantic Direct Modeling Journal: Elsevier Qiang Zou Email: qiangzou@cad.zju.edu.cn Corresponding author: Corresponding author. Shuo Liu Address: State Key Laboratory of CAD & \& CG, Zhejiang University, Hangzhou, 310058, China Abstract Current direct modeling systems limit users to low-level interactions with vertices, edges, and faces, forcing designers to manage detailed geometric elements rather than focusing on high-level design intent. This paper introduces semantic direct modeling (SDM), a novel approach that lifts direct modeling from low-level geometric modifications to high-level semantic interactions. This is achieved by utilizing a large language model (LLM) fine-tuned with CAD-specific prompts, which can guide the LLM to reason through design intent and accurately interpret CAD commands, thereby allowing designers to express their intent

papers.title: Labeling CAD Parts to capture Design Intent for LLMs through Machining Feature Recognition
papers.topic: C. 特征识别与设计意图
papers.why: 把 CAD 零件**标注成带设计意图的数据**（加工特征 = 孔/槽/圆角/倒角）再喂给 LLM；正是我们“提示词 -> 特征”对照表该有的形式：每个特征带类型、参数、依据

papers.title: MBD 技术在汽车尺寸工程数字化虚拟匹配中的运用
papers.venue: 《汽车工艺与材料》(知网/万方收录)
papers.why: 汽车行业的尺寸工程做法：**MBD（基于模型的定义）+ 虚拟匹配**，把公差、基准、测量点写进模型并做装配偏差分析。对我们的启示:给特征加**基准/公差/测量点**三元信息，才能进企业实测
